external_input.description: NRA 2025 highlights increased money laundering risks via offshore shell companies.

narrative.edited_text: Retail customer segments verified. Corporate customers vetted for ultimate beneficial ownership.

gap_analysis.identified_risk: Information gaps regarding beneficial owners of complex legal entities.
gap_analysis.gap_description: Lack of independent registry verification for foreign holding structures.
gap_analysis.proportionality_note: Genos Bank is a medium retail provider, so registry validation is targeted to high-risk PEP-linked holdings.

action_items.recommendation: Maintain conservative risk limits for high-risk offshore legal structures.
Update board-approved CDD policy to mandate verification of foreign registers.
Publish updated beneficial ownership verification guidelines for analysts.
Train corporate onboarding staff on complex shareholding structures.
